note: Moderated calibration sample. A complete but generic proposal: all components present, broad title, methodology named but not operationalised, descriptive literature review, several uncited reference entries, and a generic ethics section. Official marks: 6, 5, 5, 6, 5.

clo2_org.evidence: Complete structure: background, problem statement, significance, questions, objectives, literature review, methodology, Gantt chart, ethics, references.
clo2_org.rationale: All components are present and readable, but the problem statement runs long and repeats the introduction, so coherence is good rather than excellent.

clo2_align.evidence: The central question and the four listed research questions do not match, and the objectives are not one-to-one with them.
clo2_align.rationale: The title is broad and success/failure is never defined operationally; alignment across title, problem, questions, objectives and methodology is only moderate.

clo2_lit.evidence: The review proceeds factor by factor, one paragraph per driver, without comparing or synthesising sources.
clo2_lit.rationale: Literature is relevant but descriptive; the gap is asserted rather than established through critical discussion.

clo3_integrity.evidence: Fifteen references in broadly APA style, but several entries are never cited in the text and some citations are broken.
clo3_integrity.rationale: Citation practice is appropriate overall with several inaccuracies, matching the Good band rather than Excellent.

clo3_ethics.evidence: Ethics covers voluntariness, confidentiality, anonymity and secure data handling in general terms.
clo3_ethics.rationale: Awareness is basic and generic: the approval pathway is non-committal and the risks are not tied to this study.

comments.anchor: An Analytical Study on the Factors Contributing to the
comments.comment: Title is too broad: no country, sector or business population. Narrow it and define operationally what counts as 'success' and 'failure' (e.g. survival beyond 3 years, profitability).

comments.anchor: Several studies have addressed the dynamics
comments.comment: 'Several studies have addressed...' gives no author, year or source. Cite the studies from your reference list so the claimed gap is evidenced.
'Descriptive analytical approach' is not a recognised design. State the design, sampling frame, sample size, instruments and analysis plan, with justification.

strengths: Complete proposal structure from background through references.
Recent, relevant reference list in broadly APA format.
Clear awareness of internal and external drivers of small business outcomes.
Ethics section addresses voluntariness, confidentiality, anonymity and secure data handling.
improvements: Narrow the title and define success and failure operationally; one set of research questions only.
Replace the generic descriptive design with a justified design, sampling frame, sample size, instruments and analysis plan.
Cite the studies referred to in the introduction and problem statement; remove or cite unused reference entries.
Convert the literature review from descriptive summaries into a critical, thematic synthesis that establishes the gap.
Make the ethics section study-specific and state the approval pathway before data collection.
